title: 一次周末购物
titlePinyin: yī cì zhōu mò gòu wù

explanations.1: ‘家’ is a measure word for shops like supermarkets.
explanations.2: ‘里’ is a location noun meaning inside, used with ‘从…出发’.
explanations.3: ‘很’ is an adverb of degree modifying ‘多’.
explanations.4: ‘什么’ is a question pronoun asking about items to buy.
explanations.5: ‘先’ is a time adverb indicating sequence.
explanations.6: ‘这些’ is a demonstrative pronoun referring to the apples.
explanations.7: ‘这个’ is a demonstrative pronoun asking about the price of a specific apple.
explanations.8: ‘两’ is the cardinal number used before measure words.
explanations.9: ‘个’ is a common measure word for apples.
explanations.10: ‘非常’ is an adverb of degree meaning very much.
explanations.11: ‘还’ is an adverb meaning in addition.
explanations.12: ‘也’ indicates that the speaker does the same action as the friend.
explanations.13: ‘那些’ is a demonstrative pronoun pointing to the cabbages.
explanations.14: ‘半’ means half, used with a measure word.
explanations.15: ‘没有’ is a negative adverb for past actions.

translation: On the weekend, I went to a supermarket with my friend. We set out from home and took a car to get there. There were many people at the supermarket entrance; inside it was also very lively. My friend asked me: 'What do you want to buy?' I said: 'I want to buy some fruit and vegetables.' First we went to the fruit section; there were apples, bananas, and oranges. I thought these apples were very fresh, so I asked: 'How much is this one?' My friend said: 'Two yuan per jin.' So I bought two of them. Then we went to the vegetable section; my friend likes to eat tomatoes very much; she will buy a lot. She also bought some cucumbers, and I also bought some cabbage. My friend said again: 'Those cabbages are very cheap, you can buy a bit more.' I said: 'Okay, I'll buy half a jin.' Finally, we checked out together. I didn't bring cash, so I paid by phone.
